## Install

1. Install [Ollama](https://ollama.com) and keep it running.
2. In a terminal, run `ollama pull llama3.2:3b` (about 2 GB, once).
3. Download the zip below and unzip it somewhere you'll keep it.
4. Open `chrome://extensions`, turn on **Developer mode**, click **Load unpacked** and pick the unzipped folder.
5. Pin Tether and click its icon to open the side panel.

Works in Chrome, Chromium, Brave and Edge. Without Ollama it still works, with simple suggestions.
